name: audit-registry-snapshot-ast-removal
title: Remove skill_review AST registry fallback once both packs ship snapshots
description: BLOCKED ON 08-04-audit-registry-snapshot-sd-twin. Once both SE and SD packs ship the generated registry snapshot producer, a bounded PR removes _parse_registry and its AST helpers (_assignment, _string_value, _call_value) plus the fallback branch and symlink-fallback path in skill_review.py, and makes _load_registry_snapshot the sole registry source. This meets the strict acceptance criterion 'skill_review.py no longer opens installer/registry.py' fleet-wide. Update the code-spec quality-guidelines.md snapshot-preferred section and drop the AST-fallback tests. Do not start until the SD twin producer has shipped.
creator: sdelmas
notes: Blocked on 08-04-audit-registry-snapshot-sd-twin. Until 2026-08-06 that blocker existed only as 'BLOCKED ON ...' prose in prd.md's Goal, which candidate_block_status (scripts/sd-ai-command-pack-work-loop.py:850-870) cannot read -- an autonomous run could have selected it. Now carries blocked/blockedOn/blockedReason, the explicit-flag surface of that helper's three-surface convention. Removal surface: _parse_registry (:340), _assignment (:224), _string_value (:235), _call_value (:241), fallback branch (:427-428), and the None return at :317-318. Two things must not regress: the _crosses_symlink refusal is a security property and must become fail-closed rather than disappear, and non-first-party repo-local checkouts ship no snapshot, so pack parity is not fleet coverage. Sequencing: ten active tasks edit .trellis/spec/backend/quality-guidelines.md. Cluster membership is decided by the PRD's stated deliverable -- a Requirement or acceptance criterion that writes to that file -- not by whether implement.jsonl lists it, since the manifest is a read-for-context list and several non-cluster tasks cite the file as a contract to read. `order` 30 within the P3 band encodes the intended landing sequence (snapshot section, disjoint from the ship/review sections; blocked anyway). Tasks with no `order` sort as 0 and therefore run before this cluster, which is intended: they do not contend for this file.
blockedReason: SD pack must ship generated/registry-snapshot.json before the AST fallback can be removed fleet-wide
